basic_info.description: A rare offering at 35 Dolores, this expansive three-bedroom residence blends the privacy of a single-family home with the amenities of a boutique luxury building. Enjoy direct entry via a private hallway off the main lobby, creating an unparalleled sense of exclusivity.  The open-concept layout is anchored by a chef's kitchen w/ Viking appliances, quartz counters, & custom cabinetry offering abundant storage. Living and dining areas flow seamlessly onto the building's largest, most private corner patioideal for entertaining or quiet outdoor retreat. Three spacious bedrooms, including a serene primary suite with spa-inspired bath, are complemented by generous closets & thoughtful built-ins that simplify city living.  Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, deeded parking with two oversized storage cages, & building amenities such as a landscaped garden, dog run, car wash station, & private guest suite with full kitchen. Perfectly sited along iconic Dolores Street across from Whole Foods & steps to Dolores Park, the Castro, Mission, & Hayes Valley, this home offers both sanctuary & connectivity in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods. | See more at: ThirtyFiveDolores.com
